summary: R4, R6, R12 and R13 fail. Three supported defects affect reviewer source fidelity, retention of executed-check receipts, and reconciliation of reopened findings. The other 17 criteria pass.

criteria.title: Planning and milestone authority
criteria.explanation: The core retains planning approvals and checks current commitments, required proof, acceptance, merge authority and integration at the four milestones. Corrective edits and individual commits remain available.

criteria.title: Model-led execution
criteria.explanation: Readiness records a declaration without launching review. Execution has no incidental scheduling graph or remediation counter; spec and Judge retain their genuine Verification input requirement.

criteria.title: Canonical layouts
criteria.explanation: The trusted resolver and local object store support repository-local and parent-folder records independently of evidence tracking or commits. Tracked record material is excluded from application snapshots.

criteria.title: Exact source and requirements
criteria.explanation: Requirement bytes, authority and source identities are bound, but ordinary executable modes are erased from the reviewer view. A 100644-to-100755 change produces identical 0400 base/head files, while packet metadata includes only special entry kinds. The reviewer cannot inspect this actual source change.
evidence: Read-only in-memory execution probe: baseMode=100644, headMode=100755, exported modes=[400,400,400], identical exported bytes, source.entries=[], fixture verdict admitted as PASS.

criteria.title: Containment and isolation
criteria.explanation: Canonical reads reject traversal and symlinks, historical source exports filter retained records, and reviewer assembly restricts repository scope. Provider requests and receipt admission require fresh, read-only execution with network denied.

criteria.title: Publication and retention
criteria.explanation: Exclusive object publication and journal reconciliation are present, but earlier executed checks lose their retained receipt bindings when a later check fails preflight. The shared Verification/finalization runner keeps receipts only in memory until successful return or its post-command drift catch; later repository, argument, purpose or checkout errors bypass that retention.
evidence: Read-only execution-service probe with injected command failure followed by an unselected repository: one check invoked, gate UNAVAILABLE, result.artifacts=[], no retained check-receipt object.

criteria.title: Local finalization
criteria.explanation: Packet inventories and reference closure are generated by the core. Source cleanliness, configured repository identity, remote synchronization and reviewed-content integration checks remain separate from optional evidence tracking.

criteria.title: Independent grouped verdicts
criteria.explanation: Grouped code/spec execution validates each verdict separately and preserves a valid verdict when its companion is absent. Receipt checks reject inherited or implementing contexts. Formal Verification includes an actual fresh code-evaluator receipt; grouped behavior is covered by injected provider-contract tests.

criteria.title: Complete obligation inventory
criteria.explanation: The current inventory retains context, reconciliation, Verification, spec, pattern, independent Judge, code review, triage, explanation, packet, finalization, release and retention, with optional whiteboard policy. Runner and observation roles have concrete execution paths.

criteria.title: Equivalent-input reuse
criteria.explanation: Applicability compares retained content and execution assumptions while preserving original result provenance. Identical source content at a new commit and bookkeeping-equivalent candidates can reuse qualifying proof.

criteria.title: Relevant change and uncertainty
criteria.explanation: Source, target, requirements, supporting records, consumed evidence, pattern inputs and runner assumptions participate in applicability. Missing historical evidence creates a freshness barrier, and external validity windows are checked.

criteria.title: Targeted delta coverage
criteria.explanation: Delta records bind prior proof and require changed-path/interactions assertions, but ordinary mode-only changes remain invisible in both current and prior reviewer exports. Naming the changed path cannot establish coverage of an executable-mode transition that the evaluator was never supplied.

criteria.title: Bounded history and dispositions
criteria.explanation: Automatic finding-state projection handles resolved and unsupported dispositions but ignores present. After a finding is closed and subsequently reopened through a supported present disposition, the next review can receive neither the reopening report nor a required disposition. With changed inputs it instead receives the older finding/closure pair without the reopening evidence.
evidence: Read-only history-selection probe: FAIL finding → resolved PASS → FAIL with present disposition produced automaticallySelectedHistory=[] and reconsiderClosures=[].

criteria.title: New discovery and blocking criteria
criteria.explanation: New findings, including another instance of an existing class, remain representable. Blocking findings must reference a selected approved criterion or the gate rule; nonblocking advice does not by itself contradict PASS.

criteria.title: One scoped human decision
criteria.explanation: Decisions retain actual instruction/context and optional provenance, support expressly named continuations, preserve amendment versions, and reconcile pending/completed operations without requiring another human approval.

criteria.title: Honest exceptions and integration
criteria.explanation: Exceptions remain separate from original FAIL/UNAVAILABLE outcomes, source drift invalidates candidate-scoped applicability, merge authority must name the prepared action, and integration is observed independently.

criteria.title: Enforcement coverage
criteria.explanation: Protected merge rechecks core eligibility, exact action identity, source, target and hosted checks. Both hook manifests route recognized direct merges through the shared guard. Coverage explicitly distinguishes adapter protection, subprocess hook smoke and cooperative arbitrary-shell behavior.

criteria.title: Coherent consumers and low ceremony
criteria.explanation: CLI, native adapter and desktop consume the current core. Desktop scheduling controls and automatic evaluator launch are removed; current operations generate retained requests, results and receipts. Local consumer/build smoke is documented.

criteria.title: Direct cutover
criteria.explanation: Distribution and command registration use the current protocol, retired orchestration modules are removed, and unsupported state receives current-run guidance. No converter, staged pilot or benchmark admission requirement was introduced.

criteria.title: Resume without false history
criteria.explanation: Resume establishes a durable current run, preserves old runtime files, admits only observed current authority, and activates replacement runs through retained successor references. Old journal events are not converted into passes.

criteria.title: Practical observations
criteria.explanation: Execution receipts expose timestamps, outcomes and available provider token/cost data with unknown values retained as null. Status and result reads support inspection without a new metrics gate or fixed performance target.

markdown:
**FAIL — R4, R6, R12 and R13 fail; the other 17 criteria pass.**

Reviewed the complete FEATURE_FINAL change from `643e3ea2b03f19b66595219c4f8df934596aa436` to `3dd128fc5dae29a7b6fa829fe23a5f32e0842b4c`, using the approved specification and design. Their digests, the inventory, all 47 patch chunks, assembled patch material, formal Verification and `runtime.png` matched their supplied bindings. The inventory contains 306 text changes: 50 additions, 99 modifications and 157 deletions; no binary entries or renames. All 11 current protocol files match the staged desktop copies.

**Supported findings**

1. **F1 — Reviewer inputs lose ordinary executable modes (R4, R12).** Capture retains `100644`/`100755`, but reviewer assembly writes every base, head, target and prior file as `0400`. Packet metadata includes modes only for special `entryKind` entries. Consequently, adding or removing an ordinary executable bit is invisible, including during delta assessment: the changed path can be named without exposing its actual transition. A read-only in-memory execution harness confirmed identical exported bytes, modes `[400,400,400]`, empty source-entry metadata, and admission of a structurally valid fixture PASS. Evidence: `current/evidence.js:91`; `current/execution.js:64`, `:81`, `:217`, `:381`, under `plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/`.

2. **F2 — Later runner preflight errors strand earlier check receipts (R6).** The runner accumulates completed receipts in memory. A later invalid repository, purpose, argument list or checkout preflight can throw before the aggregate returns. The outer handler then retains an UNAVAILABLE gate result without the earlier check receipts. Output objects may remain orphaned, without their command/outcome provenance. The shared function affects both Verification and finalization and can strand earlier successful or failed checks. A read-only dependency-injected probe confirmed one invoked check followed by an unselected-repository error, `artifacts=[]`, and no retained check-receipt object. Passage remains blocked, but required evidence retention fails. Evidence: `current/execution.js:139`, `:142`, `:155`, `:163`, `:397`, `:422`.

3. **F3 — Present dispositions do not reopen automatic finding state (R13).** The output contract accepts `present`, but automatic history projection updates state only for `resolved` and `unsupported`. After FAIL → resolved PASS → supported present FAIL, it still treats the finding as closed. With equivalent inputs, the next review can receive no history or required disposition; with changed inputs, it receives the older finding/closure pair without the reopening report. A read-only selection probe confirmed empty automatic history and reconsideration lists. The latest FAIL initially blocks, but a later PASS can be admitted without reconciling the reopened finding. Evidence: `current/execution.js:186`, `:264`, `:273`, `:280`.

**Criterion assessment**

Paths beginning `current/` below refer to `plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/current/`; test references refer to `cli/test/current-core.test.js` unless otherwise named.

| ID | Result | Assessment and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | PASS | Planning authority and all four milestone predicates are enforced; corrective work remains available. `current/core.js:142`, `:294`; tests `:50`, `:283`. |
| R2 | PASS | Readiness launches no reviewer; independent work has no scheduling graph or round cap. `current/core.js:209`; `current/execution.js:224`; tests `:61`. |
| R3 | PASS | Canonical local and parent records do not require evidence commits. `current/adapter.js:12`; tests `:72`, `:283`, `:490`, `:946`. |
| R4 | FAIL | Ordinary executable-mode changes are absent from reviewer-visible evidence. Finding F1. |
| R5 | PASS | Safe canonical reads, selected-scope exports and fresh read-only/network-denied provider contracts are present. `current/store.js:11`; `current/execution.js:61`, `:122`; tests `:104`, `:653`, `:946`. |
| R6 | FAIL | Later runner preflight failure leaves earlier executed checks without retained receipt bindings. Finding F2. |
| R7 | PASS | Core-generated packet closure retains application cleanliness and PR/integration protections. `current/evidence.js:107`; `current/execution.js:483`; `current/actions.js:21`, `:99`. |
| R8 | PASS | Code/spec verdicts are validated independently; missing verdicts and inherited contexts remain unavailable. `current/execution.js:122`, `:385`; tests `:180`; bound Verification `:18`, `:24`. |
| R9 | PASS | Required gate inventory and evaluator roles remain represented, including separate Judge and completion obligations. `current/contracts.js:39`; `current/execution.js:396`, `:402`; tests `:283`. |
| R10 | PASS | Equivalent content can reuse intact proof without rewriting original execution provenance. `current/evidence.js:164`; `current/execution.js:343`; tests `:527`, `:915`. |
| R11 | PASS | Relevant source, target, requirement, environment and evidence changes invalidate applicability; evidence loss creates a freshness barrier. `current/core.js:256`, `:274`; tests `:689`, `:998`, `:1019`. |
| R12 | FAIL | Delta path assertions cannot cover executable-mode transitions omitted from current/prior reviewer inputs. Finding F1. |
| R13 | FAIL | Reopened present dispositions are omitted from automatic finding reconciliation. Finding F3. |
| R14 | PASS | New findings and old-class instances remain reportable; blocking requires an approved criterion or gate rule. `current/execution.js:178`, `:214`; tests `:202`. |
| R15 | PASS | Scoped decisions preserve provenance and amendment versions, with repeat-safe pending continuations. `current/core.js:120`, `:159`; tests `:315`, `:1066`, `:1089`. |
| R16 | PASS | Exceptions remain distinct from original outcomes and merge authority; integration is separately observed. `current/contracts.js:90`; `current/core.js:175`; tests `:472`, `:915`. |
| R17 | PASS | Protected actions recheck the core and exact action; hook coverage and cooperative limits are explicit. `current/actions.js:45`; `current/contracts.js:96`; `cli/test/current-hook.test.js:9`. |
| R18 | PASS | CLI, plugins and desktop use the current core; obsolete ordering and automatic review launch are removed. `current/adapter.js:45`; `apps/desktop/renderer/current-view.js:48`; bound Verification `:10`. |
| R19 | PASS | Current distribution removes old orchestration and provides resume guidance without conversion or benchmark prerequisites. Inventory; `cli/src/index.js:1`; `current/adapter.js:45`. |
| R20 | PASS | Resume preserves old files, durably establishes current authority and does not translate old events into passes. `current/core.js:75`, `:90`; `current/store.js:142`; tests `:329`, `:570`. |
| R21 | PASS | Receipts expose available execution metrics honestly, retaining unknown values without a metrics gate. `local-agent-adapters.js:100`; `current/execution.js:427`; `current/adapter.js:79`. |

**Explicit checks:** Scope PASS: changed work fits the approved core, consumer, packaging, test and documentation scope. Gaps FAIL: the three demonstrated paths lack required behavior and are not established by the passing formal matrix. Contradictions FAIL: reviewer input fidelity, retained execution provenance and automatic open-finding reconciliation contradict approved C2/C3 contracts.

The full bound Verification reports 260 CLI passes, 172 desktop passes, 58 Python passes, separate live code-evaluator evidence and an actual ARM64 package runtime. Its screenshot was inspected. Those results do not cover the demonstrated defects. Live grouped evaluation, installed-host interception, native Intel runtime and live hosted merge are not claimed. Review probes used in-memory dependency doubles; no repository files were changed and the full suites were not rerun.
